summary: Testing complete for Permission Fix (Armarios) and Email Registration/2FA Authentication. All features working correctly.

minor.issue: Returns 500 error intermittently, causing frontend error 'body stream already read'

integration_issues.issue: Console error 'Failed to execute json on Response: body stream already read' when maintenance endpoint fails

critical_code_review_comments: Permission check for Armarios is correctly implemented: (state.currentUser?.isAdmin || state.currentUser?.canAccessArmarios)
Email registration flow works end-to-end: register -> verification code screen
Minor: Maintenance status endpoint error handling could be improved in frontend

success_rate.backend: 95% (20/21 tests passed - 1 failed due to rate limiting)

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_NO_ARMARIOS user for permission testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested features are working: 1) Armarios permission fix verified - non-admin users without canAccessArmarios cannot see the module, 2) Email registration creates user and shows verification screen, 3) 2FA endpoints require authentication, 4) Traditional login works. SendGrid email API is configured but verification codes are stored in database for testing.

permission_fix_armarios.details: MARIO (admin) can see Armarios button. TEST_NO_ARMARIOS (non-admin without permission) cannot see Armarios button. Permission check (isAdmin || canAccessArmarios) working correctly.

email_registration.details: POST /api/auth/register creates user with verification code. UI shows registration form and verification code input after submission.

email_verification.details: POST /api/auth/verify-email validates code and activates user. Wrong code returns 400, non-existent user returns 404.

login_with_email.details: POST /api/auth/login-email authenticates verified users. Unverified users get 401.

2fa_enable.details: POST /api/auth/2fa/enable requires auth token, generates QR code and 8 backup codes.

2fa_verify.details: POST /api/auth/2fa/verify requires auth token, activates 2FA on account.

traditional_login.details: MARIO/MARIO login works, returns user data and JWT tokens.

token_refresh.details: POST /api/auth/refresh generates new access token from refresh token.

mocked_apis.SendGrid: Email API is configured but emails may not be delivered in preview environment. Verification codes are stored in database and can be retrieved for testing.
